_evidence: 0x0051b645 (nearest of 254 int16 {x,y,z} points to the colour words 0x933a14/16/18, from rgb_0051b1f9): the loop runs ecx = 0xfe down to 1 ('mov ecx,0xfe' ... 'dec ecx; jne 0x51b661'); 'cmp byte [0x95405e],0xff; jne' - any other value tests every entry, 0xff only those whose 'cmp byte [ecx+0x954060],0xff; jne' byte is 0xff, so the flag byte mixes 0xff with others and the 255-byte table 0x954060..0x95415e (ecx 1..0xfe reads 0x954061..0x95415e) mixes 0xff with 0/1/0x7f. 'lea esi,[ecx+ecx*2]; shl esi,1; add esi,[0x96a3d4]' then words [esi], [esi+2], [esi+4] are read: entries 1..0xfe lie at offsets 6..0x5f9 of the buffer [0x96a3d4], so a 0x600-byte buffer of random bytes covers every read (the words are only subtracted, sign-extended with cwde and squared with imul: every value is valid; sums of three squares <= 3*2^30 never overflow 32 bits, and 'cmp ebx,[0x933a74]; jae' compares them unsigned with the running minimum starting at 0x7fffffff). Values are synthetic.
